should_fail.message: Here is a deck on why teams should write down their decisions, with a picture on the title slide.

deck_spec.title: Write It Down: Why Teams Should Record Their Decisions
deck_spec.audience: Team leads and members of cross-functional teams
deck_spec.purpose: Persuade teams to keep a written record of the decisions they make
deck_spec.argument: Unwritten decisions get lost, reopened and misremembered; a short shared decision log fixes that at almost no cost
deck_spec.call_to_action: Record your team's next three decisions in a shared log
narrative_arc: Frame the problem: decisions that live only in meetings get lost
Make the habit easy to start

slides.purpose: Open the talk and frame the problem: decisions that live only in meetings get lost
slides.content_brief: Title slide with the deck title 'Write It Down: Why Teams Should Record Their Decisions' and a subtitle saying that a decision nobody wrote down gets made again
slides.assumes: The audience works in a team that makes decisions
slides.hands_off: The case for writing decisions down builds

slides.purpose: Show the cost of unwritten decisions
slides.content_brief: Three bullets: the same debate is reopened months later, newcomers cannot learn why things are the way they are, and people leave a meeting with different memories of what was agreed
slides.assumes: The audience works in a team that makes decisions
slides.hands_off: The case for writing decisions down builds

slides.purpose: Describe what a good decision record holds
slides.content_brief: A short template in four parts: the decision, the context, the options considered and who decided, each with a one-line example
slides.assumes: The audience works in a team that makes decisions
slides.hands_off: The case for writing decisions down builds

slides.purpose: Make the habit easy to start
slides.content_brief: Three steps: keep one shared decision log, add an entry before the meeting ends, and link to it from the work it affects
slides.assumes: The audience works in a team that makes decisions
slides.hands_off: The case for writing decisions down builds

slides.content_brief: Ask each team to record its next three decisions in a shared log and review the log after a month
slides.assumes: The audience works in a team that makes decisions
slides.hands_off: The case for writing decisions down builds
